name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university years, sparked by a chance encounter with a local racing team. Initially volunteering as a data analyst, his analytical skills and keen understanding of vehicle dynamics quickly impressed the team's management. He transitioned into race strategy, demonstrating a remarkable ability to make crucial decisions under pressure. After several successful seasons, Li Wei moved into team management, honing his leadership and organizational abilities.

Li Wei is known for his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's input is valued. He is particularly adept at identifying and nurturing young talent, and he is always looking for innovative strategies to improve team performance. His loyalty to Akkodis ASP Team is unwavering, and he is committed to leading them to continued success.

What truly sets Li Wei apart is his calm demeanor under intense pressure. While others might panic, he remains composed, analyzing the situation and making calculated decisions. This ability, combined with his technical expertise and dedication to his team, makes him a formidable sporting director.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Li Wei has a lean build and a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of green tea before every race.
